9:16 纵向构图，超写实真人摄影，韩国 Instagram 辣妹 / 韩国坏女孩私人肖像，设定在夜晚精品酒店卧室。iPhone 快照 + 复古 CCD 直闪美学，就像从私人相机胶卷中直接取出的随意照片。

一位明显的成年韩国女性，年龄 23–27 岁，拥有精致的小 oval 脸型和自然冷调白皙皮肤，保留真实的细腻皮肤纹理、可见毛孔以及皮肤色调的细微变化。长黑发散开略显凌乱，细碎发丝自然垂落在脸庞两侧。细长的猫眼型眼睛，外眼角微微上挑，冷粉裸妆，淡淡腮红，以及光泽裸粉色唇部。她的整体气质慵懒、冷漠、略带叛逆，带有韩国坏女孩的锋芒。

她总是戴着细框 oval 黑框眼镜，略微滑落到鼻梁上。她抬起眼睛，从镜片上缘越过直视镜头，目光冷峻、困倦、不经意，嘴唇自然放松微张。

她穿着合身的黑色细肩带背心，搭配深炭黑色低腰牛仔短裤，配以精致的银色项链。服装简约贴身，露出纤细的脖颈和肩膀，自然凸显的锁骨、可见的腰线，以及修长匀称的双腿。她的身材比例成熟、健康、自然且真实。

她坐在凌乱的白色酒店床沿上，双腿自然分开并向前景延伸。上身明显向前倾向镜头，肩膀微微内收，双臂自然下垂，两手位于膝盖间附近的空间。她的头部微微倾斜，向上看向镜头，营造出亲密的抓拍摄视角，仿佛摄影师就站在她正前方，从略微抬高的角度随意拍摄。

近距离高角度拍摄，35mm 等效视角。她的膝盖和双腿占据前景，而脸部保持为画面的视觉中心。使用自然透视失真，近处元素显得更大，远处元素更小，以创造真实的深度。避免精致的摄影棚姿势；保留轻微的不对称、放松的姿态，以及可信的身体重量和张力。

背景是一个略显凌乱的白色酒店床，自然散落着白色枕头和皱巴巴的床单，深灰色墙壁，以及深色木质床头板。房间光线昏暗，没有其他人存在。

复古 CCD 便携相机直闪。强烈的正面相机闪光照亮她的脸部、肩膀和双腿，在她冷调白皙的皮肤上产生真实的闪光反射，略微过曝的高光，而背景明显欠曝。冷灰色、低饱和度色调，细微数字噪点、细腻颗粒、柔焦、轻微失焦，以及淡淡的手持抖动模糊，保留廉价复古数码相机的瑕疵质感。

promptTranslations.en: 9:16 portrait composition, hyper-realistic live-action photography, Korean Instagram baddie / Korean bad girl private portrait, set in a boutique hotel bedroom at night. iPhone snapshot + vintage CCD direct-flash aesthetic, like a casual photo pulled straight from a private camera roll. An unmistakably adult Korean woman, age 23–27, with a delicate, small oval face and natural cool-toned fair skin, retaining realistic fine skin texture, visible pores, and subtle variations in skin tone. Long black hair falls loosely and slightly disheveled, with wisps of fine hair naturally draping along the sides of her face. Elongated cat-like eyes with slightly upturned outer corners, cool pink nude makeup, subtle blush, and glossy nude-pink lips. Her overall demeanor is languid, aloof, slightly rebellious, carrying a Korean bad girl edge. She consistently wears thin-framed oval black glasses, slipping slightly down the bridge of her nose. She raises her eyes, looking over the top rim of the lenses directly into the lens, with a cool, sleepy, nonchalant gaze, her lips naturally relaxed and slightly parted. She wears a fitted black spaghetti-strap camisole paired with dark charcoal-black low-waist denim shorts, complemented by a delicate silver necklace. The outfit is minimalist and form-fitting, exposing her slender neck and shoulders, naturally prominent collarbones, a visible waistline, and long, well-proportioned legs. Her body proportions are mature, healthy, natural, and realistic. She sits on the edge of an unmade white hotel bed, her legs naturally parted and extending toward the foreground. Her upper body leans noticeably forward toward the camera, shoulders slightly rounded inward, arms hanging down naturally with hands resting in the space near her knees. Her head tilts slightly, looking up at the camera to create an intimate candid perspective, as if the photographer is standing right in front of her, casually shooting from a slightly elevated angle. Close-up high-angle shot, 35mm equivalent perspective. Her knees and legs dominate the foreground, while her face remains the visual center of the frame. Natural perspective distortion is used, with closer elements appearing larger and distant elements smaller to create realistic depth. Avoid polished studio poses; retain slight asymmetry, a relaxed posture, and believable body weight and tension. The background is a slightly messy white hotel bed with naturally scattered white pillows and rumpled sheets, dark gray walls, and a dark wood headboard. The room is dimly lit, with no other people present. Vintage CCD point-and-shoot direct flash. Harsh direct frontal on-camera flash illuminates her face, shoulders, and legs, producing realistic flash reflections on her cool-toned fair skin and slightly blown-out highlights, while the background is noticeably underexposed. Cool gray, desaturated tones, subtle digital noise, fine grain, soft focus, slight misfocus, and faint handheld motion blur, preserving the imperfect texture of a cheap vintage digital camera. Korean Instagram baddie, Y2K digital camera, private bedroom photo set, candid snapshot, intimate camera-roll aesthetic, cold desaturated tones, direct flash, authentic skin texture, messy black hair, oval thin-framed glasses, high-angle close-up, leaning forward on bed, photorealistic style, imperfect handheld framing, subtle film grain, authentic early 2000s digital camera feel. No text, no watermarks, no UI elements, no extra people, no duplicate limbs, no extra fingers, no deformed hands, no warped anatomy, no exaggerated body proportions, no plastic skin, no anime, no illustration.
